meaning:
1) to be clean, be pure, be clear
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to be clean, be pure
1a2) to be clear, be justified
1b) (Piel)
1b1) to make clean, make pure, keep clean, keep pure
1c) (Hithpael)
1c1) to cleanse
1c2) to make yourself clean, purify oneself

renderings.kjv: or how can he be clean

renderings.bsb: I have kept my heart pure

elsewhere.note: What is man, that he should be clean? What is he who is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?
Against you, and you only, I have sinned, and done that which is evil in your sight, so you may be proved right when you speak, and justified when you judge.
Who can say, “I have made my heart pure. I am clean and without sin?”
Wash yourselves. Make yourself clean. Put away the evil of your doings from before my eyes. Cease to do evil.
Shall I be pure with dishonest scales, and with a bag of deceitful weights?
